thread:
Ravi: handing off now, primary to @Hannah. Observed uptick in 5xxs and p99 latency for chat.complete in ap-southeast-1. Customers reporting timeouts. I opened INC-5030. Paging is active.

alert-bot: :warning: INCIDENT INC-5030 created by Ravi 0ap-southeast-1 chat.complete latency/5xxs1 pagerduty: rot:runtime-oncall 1 https://incidents.redwood/INC-5030

Hannah: ack, taking primary. Quick summary? any config changes recently?

Ravi: small config tweak to network retry settings 90m ago but rolled out only to canary. No mass deploys. Logs show repeated `streaming session closed` and `kv_cache lock timeout`. Also seeing an increase in grpc EOFs.

Luca: infra-oncall here 1 jumping in to check node network metrics and LB health. Running scripts:
```
# check LB
rd lb status --region ap-southeast-1
# check pod restarts
rd kube get pods --selector=service=runtime -n prod --field-selector=status.phase!=Running
```

Hannah: thanks. I see a pattern of `rpc timeout` from runtime to model-hosts, and the model-host's retransmit rate is up. Could be packet loss or overloaded network interface.

Priya: security-oncall 1 ping me if you surface any auth failures or token errors. For now errors look internal. Also, remember not to paste full customer prompts in these threads.

SupportBot: Support summary: 14 tickets so far referencing slow or failed completions, some tied to high-priority customers in APAC. Draft status update queued:
"We are investigating increased latency and errors impacting chat completions in APAC. Our engineers are actively mitigating."
I'll hold until we confirm affected zones.

Hannah: routing rule suggestion for quicker triage:
- runtime exceptions (decode errors, kv-locks, model stacktraces) -> runtime-oncall
- network errors, LB health, high retransmits -> infra-oncall
- auth/permission anomalies, suspicious access -> security-oncall
- customer-impacting queries -> support (post updates) but for S1 escalate to exec oncall
Also pointer: runbook link for APAC latency: https://runbooks.redwood/runbooks/apac-latency

Ravi: noted. Adding runbook steps done so far: 1) checked canary rollout (no traffic), 2) restarted runtime replica in az-b, 3) temporarily lowered concurrency on model-hosts in az-c.

Luca: infra actions: I triggered a network interface bounce on two hosts in az-b and added a temporary high-throughput pool in ap-southeast-1. Rolling traffic to the new pool now.

alert-bot: action logged: Luca created node-pool ap-southeast-1-highnet (actor: Luca).

Hannah: after bounce + pool, p99 improved from ~4.8s to ~1.2s in az-b, but az-c still problematic. I'm going to scale down concurrency and force smaller batch sizes for models in az-c per runbook step 4.

Priya: no auth anomalies so far. One note: if you escalate and need long-term packet captures, use the secured capture appliance and notify security first.

Ravi: staffing/hand-off note: I'm offline after 21:30 UTC. Hannah will be primary until 06:30 UTC. Luca is infra-secondary, Priya security-secondary, SupportBot (Olivia) will handle external posts. If incident escalates to Sev1, page the on-call leads for runtime/infra/security.

Hannah: small coverage gap tomorrow 04:30-05:15 UTC where neither Ravi nor I are fully on-shift. Can we arrange overlap? @Luca can you cover a chunk? Or we can set up brief forwarders to follow-the-sun rotation.

Luca: I can cover 04:30-05:00 but have a meeting at 05:00. Priya can extend security coverage to 05:15 if needed.

Priya: yes I can extend to 05:15, support will handle customer msgs in parallel.

Hannah: checklist before Ravi signs off:
- [x] INC-5030 created
- [x] PD paged
- [x] runtime replica restart (az-b)
- [x] network interface bounce on two hosts
- [x] traffic shifted to high-net pool
- [ ] az-c concurrency reduction pending
- [ ] status page update (Support)

SupportBot: queued update ready to post once you confirm region impact. Suggested ETA for next update: 20m.

Hannah: posting after I see az-c trend improve or after concurrency change applied. I'll update every 10-15m or earlier.

pagerduty: PD notice: escalation `runtime-oncall` active. Next escalation in +4m if no further ack. (automated)

Ravi: thanks everyone. Hannah, please ping me if this becomes a Sev1 or if we need to call in the broader bridge.

Hannah: will do. next update in ~12m."
